fuente.titulo: Pope appeals for end to hostilities in Yemen and prays for Jordan attack victims

titular: Pope Leo appeals for peace in Yemen
bajada: He also prayed for Jordan attack victims and previewed the Assisi peace gathering
caption: After the Sunday Angelus, Pope Leo XIV called for an end to hostilities in Yemen, amid a worsening humanitarian crisis, and offered prayers for those killed in a recent attack in Jordan. He also looked ahead to the international gathering in Assisi marking 40 years since the first World Day of Prayer for Peace. Source: Vatican News, Oct 25, 2026.
